title: Image Resizer - Ignore Orientation Not Working
author: spiceygas
summary: Image Resizer's Ignore orientation option is widely misunderstood: when enabled it treats dimensions as long and short sides, while Fill versus Fit separately determines cropping.
next_action: Close the bug as expected behavior and track clearer long-side/short-side wording as a separate UX enhancement.

confidence.rationale: Multiple maintainer reproductions and the original reporter's follow-up support the expected-behavior conclusion.

judgment.rationale: Maintainer reproductions show the implementation behaving as designed, the original reporter identified human error, and the remaining concern is UI wording rather than a demonstrated resize defect.
evidence: Maintainers reproduced the four Fit/Fill and orientation combinations with expected dimensions.
The original reporter concluded that the Fill/no-ignore scenario matched the intended use case and asked whether the issue could close as user error.
Later discussion converges on confusing width/height and `Ignore orientation` terminology and possible warning or UI changes.
judgment.recommended_action: Close the bug as expected behavior and track clearer long-side/short-side wording as a separate UX enhancement.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported output matches the intended orientation and Fit/Fill model; the remaining work is product wording or guidance.

issue_context.summary: Image Resizer's Ignore orientation option is widely misunderstood: when enabled it treats dimensions as long and short sides, while Fill versus Fit separately determines cropping.
known_information: The original report is against PowerToys 0.51.1.
Fill crops to the requested aspect, while Fit preserves the whole image within bounds.
Ignore orientation swaps the size axes to follow source orientation.
inferences: Most disagreement in the thread comes from interpreting width/height literally while the option changes them into orientation-relative dimensions.
issue_context.analysis: The issue no longer establishes a code defect; a focused UX item would better define labeling, visibility, and warnings without conflating them with resizing correctness.
initial_investigation: Read all 31 live comments and the complete four-scenario reproduction.
Separated confirmed resize behavior from the unresolved terminology discussion.

actions.label: Close bug and track orientation wording

comment.body: The thread's controlled Fit/Fill tests show Image Resizer behaving as designed, and the original reporter confirmed the Fill/no-ignore case met the intended use. The remaining problem is terminology: when enabled, `Ignore orientation` effectively treats the values as long-side and short-side dimensions. Please close this as a bug and track any label, tooltip, or warning change as a separate UX enhancement.
